source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model can carry up to 6 **DRUKHARI INFANTRY** models, but no **JUMP PACK** models.

As [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations) begins, you can pick a **KABALITE WARRIORS**, **HAND OF THE ARCHON** or **WYCHES** unit of yours that has not been split before. If you do, split it into 2 units, as equal in size as possible, and note which models form each. One of the 2 has to be embarked within this model as the battle starts; the other can begin the battle aboard another **TRANSPORT**, or be deployed on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
